ValidationRule.description: Need an Approved Date before being able to go past Approved/Rejected
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(Approval_Scenario__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Presented"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Accepted"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Denied") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Quote needs to be submitted for approval before proceeding
